## Specification

### Component: Toast

Transient notifications: `<Toaster />` mounted once, plus an imperative `toast()` callable from anywhere (a tiny external store read with `useSyncExternalStore`).

#### Anatomy
```
<Toaster>                         <section class="ui-toaster" aria-label="Notifications"> in a top-layer popover
  <ol class="ui-toaster-list">
    <li class="ui-toast-slot">    stack position (transform, height)
      <div class="ui-toast">      swipe + enter/exit, data-type
        <div class="ui-toast-card"><div class="ui-toast-inner">
          .ui-toast-icon  .ui-toast-content (.ui-toast-title .ui-toast-description)  .ui-toast-actions (.ui-toast-btn)
        </div></div>
        button.ui-toast-close
```
Files: `store.ts` (store + `toast`), `types.ts`, `toaster.tsx`, `toast-item.tsx`, `use-swipe.ts`, `use-toast-layer.ts`.

#### API
- `toast(title, options?)`, `toast.success|error|warning|info|loading`, each returns the id.
- `toast.promise(promise | () => promise, { loading, success, error, description?, finally?, toasterId? })` morphs ONE toast; `success`/`error` may be a node or `(value) => node | { title, description, … }`. Returns `{ id, unwrap }`.
- `toast.dismiss(id?)` (all when omitted). Dismissed toasts stay in the store, marked `dismissed`, until their exit animation ends.
- Options: `description`, `duration` (default 4000, `Infinity` allowed; loading defaults to `Infinity`), `action` / `cancel` `{ label, onClick }` (click dismisses unless `preventDefault()`), `icon` (`false` for none), `id` (existing id updates in place, restarts the timer, revives a leaving toast), `dismissible` (default true), `important` (assertive), `closeButton`, `toasterId`, `className`, `onDismiss`, `onAutoClose`.
- `Toaster` props: `position` (`top|bottom`-`left|center|right`, default `bottom-right`), `visibleToasts` 3, `expand` false, `richColors` false, `closeButton` false, `gap` 14, `offset` (24px, 16px on phones), `duration` 4000, `label` "Notifications", `id`, `className`, `style`.

#### Stacking (Sonner-like)
- Newest toast is index 0 (front). Collapsed: toast `i` is scaled `1 - .05·i`, translated 14px·i toward the inside of the screen, shrinks to the front toast's height and hides its content; `transform-origin` is the docked edge. Toasts at or beyond `visibleToasts` fade out (and are `inert`).
- Expanded (pointer hover, focus within, or `expand`): every toast is at its own measured height; offset = sum of the heights + `gap` of the toasts in front of it. A pseudo-element bridges the gap so the pointer never leaves the list.
- Heights are measured on the content wrapper (not the slot) in a layout effect and with a `ResizeObserver`, so the stack follows content changes (promise morph).
- Leaving toasts keep their last layout, so the others glide into place.

#### Behaviour
- Timer per toast; pauses on hover, focus within, a pointer held down, and `document.hidden`; resumes with the time left. Any update restarts it.
- Swipe (pointer events, mouse/pen/touch): dismisses toward the docked edge (`right` for `*-right`, `left` for `*-left`, up/down for the vertical edge). Axis locks after 6px; pointer capture starts only then (so button clicks still work). Release past 45px or faster than .11px/ms dismisses, otherwise it springs back. Against the dismiss direction it resists (max 10px). `touch-action: none`.
- Exit: `data-removed` plays `ui-toast-out` (160ms), then the toast is removed from the store (fallback timeout 700ms). Swipe-out transitions instead.
- Keyboard: Alt+T or F8 focuses the region (remembering the previous focus); Esc on a toast dismisses it, Esc on the region restores focus.
- Top layer: the viewport is a `popover="manual"` element shown with `showPopover()`. While a modal `<dialog>` is open (found with a `MutationObserver`) the layer is moved inside it (a modal dialog makes everything else inert) and re-shown; it moves back to `<body>` when the dialog closes. Without the Popover API: fixed container, huge z-index.
- SSR: renders nothing until mounted.

#### Visual rules
- Width 356px (full width between the offsets on phones). Card: `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-shadow-lg`; padding 14px 16px; icon 20px in the status `-text` colour; title 14px/500, description 13px muted.
- Rich colours: background 8% status colour over the surface, border 30%, text in `--ui-<status>-text`.
- Buttons: 28px, action = `--ui-primary`, cancel = `--ui-secondary`. Close: 22px disc on the corner; hidden until hover/focus on `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.

#### Motion
- Entrance `ui-toast-in` 380ms `--ui-ease-out`: from the docked edge (up to 56px), scale .96, 2px blur. Stack transform/height on `--ui-spring-smooth`. Exit faster (160ms, `--ui-ease-in`). Icon pops (`ui-pop-in`) and content cross-fades when the type changes.

#### Accessibility
- Region named "Notifications", `aria-live="polite"`, `aria-relevant="additions text"`. Error / `important` toasts: `role="alert"`, `aria-live="assertive"`.
- Never the only copy of important information; timers pause so toasts are readable.

#### Acceptance checks
- Stack collapses to scaled layers and expands on hover with real heights; no layout jump.
- A promise toast stays one element and morphs loading to success or error.
- Swipe past the threshold dismisses; a short swipe springs back; works with touch.
- Toasts are visible and interactive above an open modal dialog.
- Timers pause on hover; Alt+T focuses the region.

### `ui/components/toast/store.ts`

```ts
import { isValidElement, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type {
  ToastId,
  ToastOptions,
  ToastPromiseMessages,
  ToastPromiseResult,
  ToastRecord,
  ToastType,
} from './types';

/*
 * A tiny external store. `toast()` can be called from anywhere (event
 * handlers, data layers, outside React); <Toaster /> reads it with
 * useSyncExternalStore. Every change replaces the array, so snapshots are
 * stable between changes.
 */

const EMPTY: ToastRecord[] = [];
let toasts: ToastRecord[] = EMPTY;
let counter = 0;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function emit(next: ToastRecord[]) {
  toasts = next;
  listeners.forEach((l) => l());
}

export function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}
export const getSnapshot = () => toasts;
export const getServerSnapshot = () => EMPTY;

/** Create a toast, or update the one with the same id in place. */
function create(type: ToastType, title: ReactNode, options: ToastOptions = {}): ToastId {
  const id = options.id ?? `ui-toast-${++counter}`;
  const existing = toasts.find((t) => t.id === id);
  if (existing) {
    // An update: keep its place in the stack, restart its timer, revive it if it was leaving.
    emit(
      toasts.map((t) =>
        t.id === id ? { ...t, ...options, id, type, title, dismissed: false, version: t.version + 1 } : t,
      ),
    );
  } else {
    emit([...toasts, { ...options, id, type, title, dismissed: false, version: 0 }]);
  }
  return id;
}

/** Mark toasts as dismissed. <Toaster /> removes them once their exit animation ends. */
function dismiss(id?: ToastId): ToastId | undefined {
  const leaving: ToastRecord[] = [];
  const next = toasts.map((t) => {
    if (t.dismissed || (id !== undefined && t.id !== id)) return t;
    leaving.push(t);
    return { ...t, dismissed: true };
  });
  if (!leaving.length) return id;
  emit(next);
  leaving.forEach((t) => t.onDismiss?.(t));
  return id;
}

export { dismiss as dismissToast };

/** Drop a toast from the store for good (called after its exit animation). */
export function removeToast(id: ToastId) {
  if (toasts.some((t) => t.id === id)) emit(toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
}

/** Test helper: empty the store. */
export function resetToasts() {
  counter = 0;
  emit(EMPTY);
}

function isResultObject(v: unknown): v is ToastOptions & { title: ReactNode } {
  return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !isValidElement(v) && 'title' in v;
}

function resolveResult(result: ToastPromiseResult, fallback: ToastOptions): { title: ReactNode; options: ToastOptions } {
  return isResultObject(result)
    ? { title: result.title, options: { ...fallback, ...result } }
    : { title: result as ReactNode, options: fallback };
}

function promise<T>(source: Promise<T> | (() => Promise<T>), messages: ToastPromiseMessages<T>) {
  const id = create('loading', messages.loading, { description: messages.description, toasterId: messages.toasterId });
  const p = typeof source === 'function' ? source() : source;
  const settle = (type: ToastType, result: ToastPromiseResult | undefined) => {
    // If the user dismissed it while pending, leave it dismissed.
    const current = toasts.find((t) => t.id === id);
    if (result === undefined || result === null || result === false || !current || current.dismissed) {
      dismiss(id);
      return;
    }
    const { title, options } = resolveResult(result, { description: messages.description });
    create(type, title, { ...options, id });
  };
  p.then(
    (data) => settle('success', typeof messages.success === 'function' ? messages.success(data) : messages.success),
    (err) => settle('error', typeof messages.error === 'function' ? messages.error(err) : messages.error),
  ).finally(() => messages.finally?.());
  return { id, unwrap: () => p };
}

type Creator = (title: ReactNode, options?: ToastOptions) => ToastId;

const withType =
  (type: ToastType): Creator =>
  (title, options) =>
    create(type, title, options);

/**
 * Show a toast. Mount <Toaster /> once; call this from anywhere.
 *   toast('Saved');  toast.success('Invoice sent', { description: '…' });
 *   toast.promise(save(), { loading: 'Saving…', success: 'Saved', error: 'Failed' });
 *   toast.dismiss(id)   — or toast.dismiss() for all
 */
export const toast = Object.assign(withType('default'), {
  success: withType('success'),
  error: withType('error'),
  warning: withType('warning'),
  info: withType('info'),
  loading: withType('loading'),
  promise,
  dismiss,
});
```

### `ui/components/toast/toast-item.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type CSSProperties, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { animationsFinished } from '../../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '../../icons/icon';
import { dismissToast, removeToast } from './store';
import type { ToastButton, ToastRecord, ToastType } from './types';
import { useSwipe, type SwipeDirection } from './use-swipe';

const TYPE_ICON: Partial<Record<ToastType, IconName>> = {
  success: 'circle-check',
  error: 'circle-x',
  warning: 'triangle-alert',
  info: 'info',
};

export interface ToastItemProps {
  toast: ToastRecord;
  /** 0 is the newest, in front. */
  index: number;
  /** Total live toasts, for z-order. */
  count: number;
  /** Measured height (px); undefined before the first measurement. */
  height: number | undefined;
  /** Height of the front toast (px) — stacked toasts shrink to it. */
  frontHeight: number;
  /** Distance (px) from the anchored edge when the list is expanded. */
  offset: number;
  expanded: boolean;
  /** Within `visibleToasts`. */
  visible: boolean;
  visibleToasts: number;
  /** Timers stop while true (hover, focus, hidden tab, finger down). */
  paused: boolean;
  duration: number;
  closeButton: boolean;
  directions: SwipeDirection[];
  onHeight: (id: ToastRecord['id'], height: number) => void;
}

/** One toast: the stacking slot, the card, its timer, swipe and exit. */
export function ToastItem({
  toast: t,
  index,
  count,
  height,
  frontHeight,
  offset,
  expanded,
  visible,
  visibleToasts,
  paused,
  duration: defaultDuration,
  closeButton,
  directions,
  onHeight,
}: ToastItemProps) {
  const slotRef = useRef<HTMLLIElement>(null);
  const toastRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const innerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const dismissible = t.dismissible !== false;
  const duration = t.duration ?? (t.type === 'loading' ? Infinity : defaultDuration);

  // Toasts past `visibleToasts` are invisible, so they must not take focus either.
  useEffect(() => {
    slotRef.current?.toggleAttribute('inert', !visible);
  }, [visible]);

  /* Measure the content (not the slot, which is forced to the front height when stacked). */
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const inner = innerRef.current;
    const card = cardRef.current;
    if (!inner || !card) return;
    const measure = () => {
      const border = card.offsetHeight - card.clientHeight;
      onHeight(t.id, inner.offsetHeight + border);
    };
    measure();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
    ro.observe(inner);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [t.id, onHeight]);

  /* Timer: pauses and resumes with the time left; any update restarts it. */
  const remaining = useRef(duration);
  useEffect(() => {
    remaining.current = duration;
  }, [t.version, t.type, duration]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (t.dismissed || paused || !Number.isFinite(duration)) return;
    const started = Date.now();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      t.onAutoClose?.(t);
      dismissToast(t.id);
    }, Math.max(0, remaining.current));
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      remaining.current -= Date.now() - started;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [paused, t.dismissed, t.version, t.type, duration]);

  /* After the exit animation, drop it from the store. */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!t.dismissed) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const done = () => {
      if (!cancelled) removeToast(t.id);
    };
    const fallback = setTimeout(done, 700);
    animationsFinished(slotRef.current).then(done);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearTimeout(fallback);
    };
  }, [t.dismissed, t.id]);

  const { swiping, swipedOut, handlers } = useSwipe(toastRef, {
    enabled: dismissible && !t.dismissed,
    directions,
    onDismiss: () => dismissToast(t.id),
  });

  /* Behind the front toast and not expanded: shrink to the front's height, hide the content. */
  const behind = !expanded && index > 0;
  const stackIndex = Math.min(index, Math.max(visibleToasts, 1) - 1); // hidden toasts park behind the last visible one
  const style = {
    '--ui-toast-index': stackIndex,
    '--ui-toast-z': count - index,
    '--ui-toast-offset': `${offset}px`,
    '--ui-toast-front': `${frontHeight}px`,
    ...(height !== undefined && { '--ui-toast-height': `${height}px` }),
  } as CSSProperties;

  // Content swaps (loading -> success) fade in, but not on first paint.
  const mounted = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true;
  }, []);

  const assertive = t.type === 'error' || t.important === true;
  const icon = renderIcon(t);

  return (
    <li
      ref={slotRef}
      className="ui-toast-slot"
      data-toast-id={String(t.id)}
      data-index={index}
      data-front={index === 0}
      data-visible={visible}
      data-expanded={expanded}
      data-behind={behind}
      data-removed={t.dismissed}
      style={style}
    >
      <div
        ref={toastRef}
        className={cn('ui-toast', t.className)}
        data-type={t.type}
        data-swiping={swiping}
        data-swipe-out={swipedOut}
        role={assertive ? 'alert' : undefined}
        aria-live={assertive ? 'assertive' : undefined}
        aria-atomic="true"
        {...handlers}
      >
        <div ref={cardRef} className="ui-toast-card">
          <div ref={innerRef} className="ui-toast-inner">
            {icon}
            <div key={`content-${t.type}`} className={cn('ui-toast-content', mounted.current && 'ui-toast-swap')}>
              <div className="ui-toast-title">{t.title}</div>
              {t.description != null && t.description !== false && <div className="ui-toast-description">{t.description}</div>}
            </div>
            {(t.cancel || t.action) && (
              <div className="ui-toast-actions">
                {t.cancel && <ToastButtonView button={t.cancel} id={t.id} cancel />}
                {t.action && <ToastButtonView button={t.action} id={t.id} />}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        {dismissible && (t.closeButton ?? closeButton) && (
          <button type="button" className="ui-toast-close" aria-label="Close notification" onClick={() => dismissToast(t.id)}>
            <Icon name="x" size={12} strokeWidth={2} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

function renderIcon(t: ToastRecord): ReactNode {
  if (t.icon === false) return null;
  let content: ReactNode = t.icon;
  if (content == null) {
    if (t.type === 'loading') content = <span className="ui-toast-spinner" role="presentation" />;
    else if (TYPE_ICON[t.type]) content = <Icon name={TYPE_ICON[t.type]!} size={18} />;
  }
  if (content == null) return null;
  // Keyed by type so a promise toast's icon morphs when its state changes.
  return (
    <span key={t.icon ? 'custom' : t.type} className="ui-toast-icon" aria-hidden="true">
      {content}
    </span>
  );
}

function ToastButtonView({ button, id, cancel }: { button: ToastButton; id: ToastRecord['id']; cancel?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={cn('ui-toast-btn', cancel && 'ui-toast-btn-cancel')}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        button.onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) dismissToast(id);
      }}
    >
      {button.label}
    </button>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/toast/toaster.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  useSyncExternalStore,
  type CSSProperties,
  type FocusEvent,
  type KeyboardEvent,
} from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { dismissToast, getServerSnapshot, getSnapshot, subscribe } from './store';
import { ToastItem } from './toast-item';
import type { ToasterPosition } from './types';
import { useToastLayer } from './use-toast-layer';
import type { SwipeDirection } from './use-swipe';

export interface ToasterProps {
  /** Name for this Toaster, so `toast(…, { toasterId })` can target it. Only needed with several Toasters. */
  id?: string;
  /** Where the stack docks. Default `bottom-right`. */
  position?: ToasterPosition;
  /** How many toasts show at once; older ones wait out of sight. Default 3. */
  visibleToasts?: number;
  /** Keep the stack expanded instead of collapsed behind the newest toast. */
  expand?: boolean;
  /** Tint toasts by type (success, error, warning, info). */
  richColors?: boolean;
  /** Show a × button on every toast. */
  closeButton?: boolean;
  /** Space between expanded toasts, px. Default 14. */
  gap?: number;
  /** Distance from the screen edge: a number (px) or any CSS length. Default 24px (16px on phones). */
  offset?: number | string;
  /** Default auto-dismiss time in ms. Default 4000. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Accessible name of the region. Default `Notifications`. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

function directionsFor(position: ToasterPosition): SwipeDirection[] {
  const [y, x] = position.split('-') as ['top' | 'bottom', 'left' | 'center' | 'right'];
  const out: SwipeDirection[] = [y === 'top' ? 'up' : 'down'];
  if (x === 'left') out.push('left');
  if (x === 'right') out.push('right');
  return out;
}

const cssLength = (v: number | string) => (typeof v === 'number' ? `${v}px` : v);

interface Layout {
  index: number;
  offset: number;
}

/**
 * Toaster — mount once (e.g. in your root layout); call `toast()` from anywhere.
 * Renders into the top layer so toasts sit above modal dialogs.
 */
export function Toaster({
  id,
  position = 'bottom-right',
  visibleToasts = 3,
  expand = false,
  richColors = false,
  closeButton = false,
  gap = 14,
  offset,
  duration = 4000,
  label = 'Notifications',
  className,
  style,
}: ToasterProps) {
  const all = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot);
  const toasts = useMemo(() => all.filter((t) => t.toasterId === id), [all, id]);
  const countRef = useRef(0);
  countRef.current = toasts.length;
  const layer = useToastLayer();
  const regionRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const returnFocus = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  const [heights, setHeights] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [pressed, setPressed] = useState(false);
  const [pageHidden, setPageHidden] = useState(false);

  const onHeight = useCallback((id: string | number, h: number) => {
    setHeights((prev) => (prev[String(id)] === h ? prev : { ...prev, [String(id)]: h }));
  }, []);

  /* Alt+T or F8 moves focus to the region; Esc hands it back. */
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: globalThis.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (!((e.altKey && e.code === 'KeyT') || e.key === 'F8')) return;
      const region = regionRef.current;
      if (!region || !countRef.current) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      if (active && !region.contains(active)) returnFocus.current = active;
      region.focus();
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [layer]);

  /* Timers stop while the tab is hidden. */
  useEffect(() => {
    const onVisibility = () => setPageHidden(document.hidden);
    onVisibility();
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
  }, []);

  /* …and while a finger or button is held down on a toast (e.g. mid-swipe). */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pressed) return;
    const up = () => setPressed(false);
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
    document.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('pointerup', up);
      document.removeEventListener('pointercancel', up);
    };
  }, [pressed]);

  /* Stack order: newest first. Leaving toasts keep the place they had. */
  const lastLayout = useRef(new Map<string, Layout>());
  const { layout, frontHeight, liveCount } = useMemo(() => {
    const live = toasts.filter((t) => !t.dismissed).reverse();
    const map = new Map<string, Layout>();
    let acc = 0;
    live.forEach((t, index) => {
      map.set(String(t.id), { index, offset: acc });
      acc += (heights[String(t.id)] ?? 0) + gap;
    });
    return { layout: map, frontHeight: live[0] ? (heights[String(live[0].id)] ?? 0) : 0, liveCount: live.length };
  }, [toasts, heights, gap]);
  layout.forEach((v, k) => lastLayout.current.set(k, v));
  // Forget layouts of toasts that are gone
  lastLayout.current.forEach((_, k) => {
    if (!toasts.some((t) => String(t.id) === k)) lastLayout.current.delete(k);
  });

  // Drop measurements of removed toasts
  useEffect(() => {
    setHeights((prev) => {
      const ids = new Set(toasts.map((t) => String(t.id)));
      const keys = Object.keys(prev);
      if (keys.every((k) => ids.has(k))) return prev;
      return Object.fromEntries(keys.filter((k) => ids.has(k)).map((k) => [k, prev[k]!]));
    });
  }, [toasts]);

  if (!layer) return null;

  const [y, x] = position.split('-') as ['top' | 'bottom', 'left' | 'center' | 'right'];
  const expanded = expand || hovered || focused;
  const paused = hovered || focused || pressed || pageHidden;
  const directions = directionsFor(position);

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape' || e.defaultPrevented) return;
    const slot = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>('[data-toast-id]');
    const record = slot && toasts.find((t) => String(t.id) === slot.dataset.toastId);
    if (record && record.dismissible === false) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (record) dismissToast(record.id);
    const back = returnFocus.current;
    returnFocus.current = null;
    if (back?.isConnected) back.focus();
    else (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.blur();
  };

  const onBlur = (e: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setFocused(false);
  };

  const regionStyle = {
    '--ui-toaster-gap': `${gap}px`,
    ...(offset !== undefined && { '--ui-toaster-offset': cssLength(offset) }),
    ...style,
  } as CSSProperties;

  return createPortal(
    <section
      ref={regionRef}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-live="polite"
      aria-relevant="additions text"
      aria-atomic="false"
      tabIndex={-1}
      className={cn('ui-toaster', className)}
      data-y={y}
      data-x={x}
      data-expanded={expanded}
      data-rich-colors={richColors || undefined}
      style={regionStyle}
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      onFocus={() => setFocused(true)}
      onBlur={onBlur}
      onPointerEnter={(e) => e.pointerType !== 'touch' && setHovered(true)}
      onPointerLeave={() => setHovered(false)}
      onPointerDown={() => setPressed(true)}
    >
      <ol className="ui-toaster-list">
        {toasts.map((t) => {
          const l = layout.get(String(t.id)) ?? lastLayout.current.get(String(t.id)) ?? { index: 0, offset: 0 };
          return (
            <ToastItem
              key={t.id}
              toast={t}
              index={l.index}
              count={liveCount}
              height={heights[String(t.id)]}
              frontHeight={frontHeight}
              offset={l.offset}
              expanded={expanded}
              visible={l.index < visibleToasts}
              visibleToasts={visibleToasts}
              paused={paused}
              duration={duration}
              closeButton={closeButton}
              directions={directions}
              onHeight={onHeight}
            />
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </section>,
    layer,
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/toast/types.ts`

```ts
import type { MouseEvent, ReactNode } from 'react';

export type ToastId = string | number;

export type ToastType = 'default' | 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'loading';

export type ToasterPosition = 'top-left' | 'top-center' | 'top-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-center' | 'bottom-right';

export interface ToastButton {
  /** Button label. */
  label: ReactNode;
  /** Called on click. The toast dismisses afterwards unless you call `event.preventDefault()`. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
}

export interface ToastOptions {
  /** Second line, muted. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Milliseconds before auto-dismiss. `Infinity` keeps it until dismissed. Default 4000 (`Infinity` for loading). */
  duration?: number;
  /** Primary action button. */
  action?: ToastButton;
  /** Secondary button, left of the action. */
  cancel?: ToastButton;
  /** Custom icon. `false` removes the icon, including the built-in one for the type. */
  icon?: ReactNode | false;
  /** Id. Calling again with an existing id updates that toast in place. */
  id?: ToastId;
  /** Allow swipe, the × button and Esc to dismiss it. Default true. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Announce assertively (role="alert"). Errors always do. */
  important?: boolean;
  /** Show the × button on this toast (overrides the Toaster). */
  closeButton?: boolean;
  /** Show it in the `<Toaster id="…" />` with this id. Without it, it shows in the Toaster that has no id. */
  toasterId?: string;
  /** Class for the toast. */
  className?: string;
  /** Called when the toast is dismissed, by anything. */
  onDismiss?: (toast: ToastRecord) => void;
  /** Called when the timer dismisses it. */
  onAutoClose?: (toast: ToastRecord) => void;
}

/** What the store holds for each toast. */
export interface ToastRecord extends ToastOptions {
  id: ToastId;
  type: ToastType;
  title: ReactNode;
  /** True once dismissed: it stays in the list until its exit animation ends. */
  dismissed: boolean;
  /** Bumped on every update, so timers restart. */
  version: number;
}

export type ToastPromiseResult = ReactNode | (ToastOptions & { title: ReactNode });

export interface ToastPromiseMessages<T> {
  /** Shown while the promise is pending. */
  loading: ReactNode;
  /** Shown when it resolves. May return a string, node or `{ title, description, … }`. */
  success?: ToastPromiseResult | ((data: T) => ToastPromiseResult);
  /** Shown when it rejects. */
  error?: ToastPromiseResult | ((error: unknown) => ToastPromiseResult);
  /** Description shown in every state unless a state sets its own. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Show it in the `<Toaster id="…" />` with this id. */
  toasterId?: string;
  /** Runs after either outcome. */
  finally?: () => void;
}
```

### `ui/components/toast/use-swipe.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState, type PointerEvent, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type SwipeDirection = 'left' | 'right' | 'up' | 'down';

/** Distance (px) past which a release dismisses. */
export const SWIPE_THRESHOLD = 45;
/** Speed (px/ms) past which a quick flick dismisses, whatever the distance. */
export const SWIPE_VELOCITY = 0.11;
/** Movement (px) before the gesture picks an axis. */
const LOCK_DISTANCE = 6;

const SIGN: Record<SwipeDirection, number> = { left: -1, right: 1, up: -1, down: 1 };

interface Gesture {
  pointerId: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  time: number;
  axis: 'x' | 'y' | null;
  amount: number;
}

export interface UseSwipeOptions {
  enabled: boolean;
  /** Directions that dismiss, e.g. ['right'] for a toast docked right. */
  directions: SwipeDirection[];
  onDismiss: (direction: SwipeDirection) => void;
}

/**
 * Swipe-to-dismiss with pointer events (mouse, pen and touch alike).
 * The element follows the pointer through the CSS variables
 * `--ui-toast-swipe-x` / `--ui-toast-swipe-y`; the axis locks after 6px.
 * Releasing past 45px, or faster than .11px/ms, dismisses; otherwise it springs back.
 * Pair the element with `touch-action: none` so touch drags don't scroll the page.
 */
export function useSwipe(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, { enabled, directions, onDismiss }: UseSwipeOptions) {
  const gesture = useRef<Gesture | null>(null);
  const [swiping, setSwiping] = useState(false);
  const [swipedOut, setSwipedOut] = useState(false);
  const onDismissRef = useRef(onDismiss);
  onDismissRef.current = onDismiss;

  const setOffset = (axis: 'x' | 'y', value: number) => {
    ref.current?.style.setProperty(axis === 'x' ? '--ui-toast-swipe-x' : '--ui-toast-swipe-y', `${value}px`);
  };
  const clearOffset = () => {
    ref.current?.style.removeProperty('--ui-toast-swipe-x');
    ref.current?.style.removeProperty('--ui-toast-swipe-y');
  };

  const onPointerDown = useCallback(
    (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      if (!enabled || swipedOut || (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0)) return;
      gesture.current = { pointerId: e.pointerId, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, time: Date.now(), axis: null, amount: 0 };
    },
    [enabled, swipedOut],
  );

  const onPointerMove = useCallback(
    (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const g = gesture.current;
      if (!g || g.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
      const dx = e.clientX - g.x;
      const dy = e.clientY - g.y;
      if (!g.axis) {
        if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) < LOCK_DISTANCE) return;
        const axis = Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) ? 'x' : 'y';
        const allowed = directions.some((d) => (axis === 'x') === (d === 'left' || d === 'right'));
        if (!allowed) {
          gesture.current = null; // a drag along an axis that can't dismiss: let it be
          return;
        }
        g.axis = axis;
        // Capture only now, so a plain tap on a button inside still produces its click.
        try {
          e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        } catch {}
        window.getSelection()?.removeAllRanges();
        setSwiping(true);
      }
      const amount = g.axis === 'x' ? dx : dy;
      g.amount = amount;
      const signs = directions.filter((d) => (g.axis === 'x') === (d === 'left' || d === 'right')).map((d) => SIGN[d]);
      const allowedSign = signs.includes(Math.sign(amount));
      // Against the dismiss direction the toast resists instead of following.
      const shown = allowedSign ? amount : Math.sign(amount) * Math.min(10, Math.abs(amount) * 0.12);
      setOffset(g.axis, shown);
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [directions],
  );

  const finish = useCallback(
    (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>, cancelled: boolean) => {
      const g = gesture.current;
      if (!g || g.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
      gesture.current = null;
      if (!g.axis) return;
      try {
        e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      } catch {}
      setSwiping(false);
      const elapsed = Math.max(1, Date.now() - g.time);
      const sign = Math.sign(g.amount);
      const direction = directions.find((d) => (g.axis === 'x') === (d === 'left' || d === 'right') && SIGN[d] === sign);
      const fast = Math.abs(g.amount) / elapsed > SWIPE_VELOCITY;
      if (!cancelled && direction && (Math.abs(g.amount) >= SWIPE_THRESHOLD || fast)) {
        const el = ref.current;
        const size = (g.axis === 'x' ? el?.offsetWidth : el?.offsetHeight) ?? 0;
        setOffset(g.axis, sign * (size + 32));
        setSwipedOut(true);
        onDismissRef.current(direction);
      } else {
        clearOffset(); // springs back through the CSS transition
      }
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [directions],
  );

  return {
    swiping,
    swipedOut,
    handlers: {
      onPointerDown,
      onPointerMove,
      onPointerUp: (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => finish(e, false),
      onPointerCancel: (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => finish(e, true),
    },
  };
}
```

### `ui/components/toast/use-toast-layer.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

type PopoverElement = HTMLElement & { showPopover?: () => void; hidePopover?: () => void };

const MODAL_SELECTORS = [
  'dialog[open]:modal:not([data-state="closed"])',
  'dialog[open][aria-modal="true"]:not([data-state="closed"])',
];

/** The topmost open modal <dialog> that is not already closing. */
function findModalDialog(): HTMLElement | null {
  for (const selector of MODAL_SELECTORS) {
    try {
      const all = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(selector);
      if (all.length) return all[all.length - 1] ?? null;
    } catch {
      // :modal not supported: try the next selector
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Open the layer in the browser's top layer (above every dialog), moving it to the front. */
function showInTopLayer(layer: PopoverElement) {
  if (typeof layer.showPopover !== 'function') return;
  try {
    if (layer.matches(':popover-open')) layer.hidePopover?.();
    layer.showPopover();
  } catch {
    // Not connected yet, or already open: nothing to do
  }
}

/**
 * Creates the element toasts render into and keeps it above everything.
 *
 * It is a `popover="manual"` element, so it lives in the top layer and shows
 * above modal dialogs. A modal dialog makes the rest of the page inert though,
 * which would freeze the toasts (no hover, no clicks). So while a modal dialog
 * is open the layer moves inside it, and moves back to <body> when it closes.
 * Browsers without the Popover API get a fixed, high z-index container.
 */
export function useToastLayer(): HTMLElement | null {
  const [layer, setLayer] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = document.createElement('div') as PopoverElement;
    el.className = 'ui-toaster-layer';
    const hasPopover = typeof el.showPopover === 'function';
    if (hasPopover) el.setAttribute('popover', 'manual');
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    if (hasPopover) showInTopLayer(el);

    let frame = 0;
    const sync = () => {
      frame = 0;
      const target = findModalDialog() ?? document.body;
      if (el.parentElement === target) return;
      target.appendChild(el); // moving hides a popover, so show it again, on top
      if (hasPopover) showInTopLayer(el);
    };
    const schedule = () => {
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(sync);
    };
    const observer = new MutationObserver(schedule);
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
      subtree: true,
      childList: true,
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['open', 'data-state'],
    });
    setLayer(el);

    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      el.remove();
      setLayer(null);
    };
  }, []);

  return layer;
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/toast.css`

```css
/* Toast -------------------------------------------------------------------
   div.ui-toaster-layer  [popover="manual"]  full-viewport top layer, no pointer events
     section.ui-toaster  [data-y=top|bottom] [data-x=left|center|right] [data-rich-colors]
       ol.ui-toaster-list
         li.ui-toast-slot  stack position: --ui-toast-index / -offset / -height / -front
           div.ui-toast  [data-type] [data-swiping] [data-swipe-out]   swipe + enter/exit
             div.ui-toast-card > div.ui-toast-inner
               .ui-toast-icon  .ui-toast-content (.ui-toast-title .ui-toast-description)
               .ui-toast-actions > .ui-toast-btn [.ui-toast-btn-cancel]
             button.ui-toast-close
   Collapsed: older toasts sit behind the newest, scaled 1 - .05 * index, peeking 14px.
   Expanded (hover, focus or `expand`): a list, using each toast's measured height.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-toaster-layer {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    overflow: visible;
    pointer-events: none;
    /* Browsers without the Popover API fall back to the highest z-index */
    z-index: 2147483000;
  }

  .ui-toaster {
    --ui-toaster-offset: 1.5rem;
    --ui-toaster-width: 22.25rem;
    --ui-toaster-peek: 14px;
    --ui-toast-edge: 1; /* +1 docked at the bottom (enters and leaves downwards), -1 at the top */
    position: absolute;
    width: var(--ui-toaster-width);
    outline: none;
    pointer-events: none;
    font-family: var(--ui-font-sans);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
  }
  .ui-toaster[data-y="top"] { --ui-toast-edge: -1; top: calc(var(--ui-toaster-offset) + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); }
  .ui-toaster[data-y="bottom"] { bottom: calc(var(--ui-toaster-offset) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); }
  .ui-toaster[data-x="left"] { left: var(--ui-toaster-offset); }
  .ui-toaster[data-x="right"] { right: var(--ui-toaster-offset); }
  .ui-toaster[data-x="center"] { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
  /* Phones: full width between the offsets, whatever the position */
  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .ui-toaster { --ui-toaster-offset: 1rem; }
    .ui-toaster[data-x] { left: var(--ui-toaster-offset); right: var(--ui-toaster-offset); width: auto; transform: none; }
  }

  .ui-toaster-list { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

  /* The slot: where the toast sits in the stack ---------------------------- */
  .ui-toast-slot {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 0;
    height: var(--ui-toast-height, auto);
    z-index: var(--ui-toast-z, 1);
    pointer-events: auto;
    list-style: none;
    /* collapsed: tuck behind the newest toast, scaled down */
    transform: translateY(calc(var(--ui-toast-edge) * -1 * var(--ui-toast-index, 0) * var(--ui-toaster-peek)))
      scale(calc(1 - var(--ui-toast-index, 0) * 0.05));
    transition:
      transform var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      height var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      opacity var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-toaster[data-y="bottom"] .ui-toast-slot { bottom: 0; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
  .ui-toaster[data-y="top"] .ui-toast-slot { top: 0; transform-origin: 50% 0; }

  .ui-toast-slot[data-behind="true"] { height: var(--ui-toast-front, auto); }
  .ui-toast-slot[data-behind="true"] .ui-toast-inner,
  .ui-toast-slot[data-behind="true"] .ui-toast-close { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-toast-slot[data-expanded="true"] {
    transform: translateY(calc(var(--ui-toast-edge) * -1 * var(--ui-toast-offset, 0px)));
  }
  .ui-toast-slot[data-visible="false"] { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-toast-slot[data-removed="true"] { pointer-events: none; }

  /* Keeps the list expanded while the pointer crosses the gap between toasts */
  .ui-toast-slot[data-expanded="true"]::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 0;
    height: calc(var(--ui-toaster-gap, 14px) + 1px);
  }
  .ui-toaster[data-y="bottom"] .ui-toast-slot::after { bottom: 100%; }
  .ui-toaster[data-y="top"] .ui-toast-slot::after { top: 100%; }

  /* The toast: colours, swipe, enter and exit ------------------------------ */
  .ui-toast {
    --ui-toast-bg: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    --ui-toast-fg: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    --ui-toast-border: var(--ui-border);
    --ui-toast-muted: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    --ui-toast-accent: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    position: relative;
    height: 100%;
    touch-action: none;
    transform: translate(var(--ui-toast-swipe-x, 0px), var(--ui-toast-swipe-y, 0px));
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
    /* `backwards`: after the entrance the swipe transform takes over again */
    animation: ui-toast-in var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) backwards;
  }
  .ui-toast[data-type="success"] { --ui-toast-accent: var(--ui-success-text); }
  .ui-toast[data-type="error"] { --ui-toast-accent: var(--ui-destructive-text); }
  .ui-toast[data-type="warning"] { --ui-toast-accent: var(--ui-warning-text); }
  .ui-toast[data-type="info"] { --ui-toast-accent: var(--ui-info-text); }
  .ui-toast[data-type="loading"] { --ui-toast-accent: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  /* Rich colours: a tint of the status colour, text in its -text token */
  .ui-toaster[data-rich-colors] .ui-toast[data-type="success"] { --ui-toast-status: var(--ui-success); --ui-toast-fg: var(--ui-success-text); --ui-toast-muted: var(--ui-success-text); }
  .ui-toaster[data-rich-colors] .ui-toast[data-type="error"] { --ui-toast-status: var(--ui-destructive); --ui-toast-fg: var(--ui-destructive-text); --ui-toast-muted: var(--ui-destructive-text); }
  .ui-toaster[data-rich-colors] .ui-toast[data-type="warning"] { --ui-toast-status: var(--ui-warning); --ui-toast-fg: var(--ui-warning-text); --ui-toast-muted: var(--ui-warning-text); }
  .ui-toaster[data-rich-colors] .ui-toast[data-type="info"] { --ui-toast-status: var(--ui-info); --ui-toast-fg: var(--ui-info-text); --ui-toast-muted: var(--ui-info-text); }
  .ui-toaster[data-rich-colors] .ui-toast[data-type="success"],
  .ui-toaster[data-rich-colors] .ui-toast[data-type="error"],
  .ui-toaster[data-rich-colors] .ui-toast[data-type="warning"],
  .ui-toaster[data-rich-colors] .ui-toast[data-type="info"] {
    --ui-toast-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-toast-status) 8%, var(--ui-surface-raised));
    --ui-toast-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-toast-status) 30%, var(--ui-border));
  }

  .ui-toast[data-swiping="true"] { transition: none; cursor: grabbing; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  .ui-toast[data-swipe-out="true"] {
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      transform var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out),
      opacity var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-in);
  }
  .ui-toast-slot[data-removed="true"] .ui-toast:not([data-swipe-out="true"]) {
    animation: ui-toast-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both;
  }

  @keyframes ui-toast-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(calc(var(--ui-toast-edge) * min(100%, 3.5rem))) scale(0.96);
      filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle));
    }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
  }
  @keyframes ui-toast-out {
    from { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
    to {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(calc(var(--ui-toast-edge) * 0.75rem)) scale(0.97);
      filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle));
    }
  }

  .ui-toast-card {
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-toast-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-toast-bg);
    color: var(--ui-toast-fg);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
  }
  .ui-toast-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.875rem 1rem;
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }

  .ui-toast-icon {
    display: grid;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--ui-toast-accent);
    animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
  .ui-toast-icon > svg { display: block; }
  .ui-toast-spinner {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    border: 2px solid currentColor;
    border-right-color: transparent;
    animation: ui-spin 0.7s linear infinite;
  }

  .ui-toast-content { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .ui-toast-swap { animation: ui-fade-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-toast-title { font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; }
  .ui-toast-description { margin-top: 0.125rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--ui-toast-muted); }

  .ui-toast-actions { display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; align-self: center; margin-inline-start: 0.25rem; }
  .ui-toast-btn {
    height: 1.75rem;
    padding-inline: 0.625rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--ui-primary);
    color: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-toast-btn-cancel { background-color: var(--ui-secondary); color: var(--ui-secondary-foreground); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-toast-btn:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 88%, var(--ui-background)); }
    .ui-toast-btn-cancel:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-secondary) 90%, var(--ui-foreground)); }
  }
  .ui-toast-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
  .ui-toast-btn:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  /* Close: a small disc on the corner. Hover-capable devices show it on hover or focus. */
  .ui-toast-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.4375rem;
    inset-inline-start: -0.4375rem;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1.375rem;
    height: 1.375rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    transition:
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  /* Larger hit area than the visible disc */
  .ui-toast-close::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -0.625rem; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-toast-close { opacity: 0; }
    .ui-toast:hover .ui-toast-close,
    .ui-toast:focus-within .ui-toast-close { opacity: 1; }
    .ui-toast-close:hover { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }
  .ui-toast-close:focus-visible { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
}
```

## Usage

**Types** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/toast/types.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { toast } from '@/ui/components/toast';

export default function ToastTypes() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast('Draft saved')}>
        Default
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast.success('Invoice #1042 sent', { description: 'Mara Okafor will get it within a minute.' })}>
        Success
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast.error('Payment declined', { description: 'The card ending 4242 was declined by the bank.' })}>
        Error
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast.warning('Storage is 90% full', { description: 'Free up space or upgrade your plan.' })}>
        Warning
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast.info('Maintenance on Sunday', { description: 'Scheduled from 02:00 to 03:00 UTC.' })}>
        Info
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast.loading('Importing 2,481 contacts…')}>
        Loading
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```
